extraObjects.description:
Create a dynamic manifests via values:
Beware: There will be no validation on these resource manifests in `extraObjects` - they must be valid k8s resources.
If you encounter issues installing/upgrading rancher while using these, please investigate these first.
- apiVersion: "networking.k8s.io/v1"
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
name: allow-https-444-to-rancher
namespace: your-namespace  # Change to the appropriate namespace
spec:
podSelector:
matchLabels:
app: rancher  # Selects pods labeled with "app: rancher"
policyTypes:
- Ingress  # Controls inbound traffic to the selected pods
ingress:
- ports:
- protocol: TCP
port: 444  # Allows only TCP traffic on port 444 (custom HTTPS port)
Since no other ingress rules are defined, all other traffic is denied by default.
- apiVersion: "networking.k8s.io/v1"
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
name: rancher-deny-ingress
namespace: cattle-system
spec:
podSelector:
matchLabels:
app: rancher
policyTypes:
- Ingress

systemRegistryInheritsPullSecrets.description:
Controls whether the configured 'imagePullSecrets' are propagated to the local
cluster and any downstream clusters which rely on the global 'systemDefaultRegistry' setting.
- If true: The 'system-default-registry-pull-secrets' setting is automatically populated
with a comma-separated list of imagePullSecret names as its default value.
- New Installs: Set this to 'true' if you are pointing to an authenticated system registry.
- Upgrades: Defaults to 'false' to prevent unintended mass downstream updates. Changing this to 'true'
will automatically update all dependent downstream clusters with these secrets.
Alternatively, existing installs may directly modify the 'system-default-registry-pull-secrets' setting
after an upgrade to better time the propagation of these secrets to downstream clusters, or define
pull secrets not used by this chart.
